title: Development fixture — synthetic heating-profile search
question: At fixed total heating energy, can a different heating deposition profile improve integrated fusion output, and does the improvement survive stricter numerical checks?
description: Synthetic data used to develop and regression-check the Aster interface. It is not a scientific result and must never be presented as one.
limitations: Profiles come from a closed-form toy expression, not from TORAX or any solver.
Every check outcome and assessment in this file was written by hand for interface development.
No model was consulted and no experiment was executed to produce these numbers.
Loaded only in development builds; it is never published in the recording catalogue.

provenance.objective: Integrated fusion energy over a fixed 5 s horizon

hypotheses.title: The objective responds to deposition radius at fixed heating energy
hypotheses.prediction: Repeating the documented configuration reproduces its recorded objective, and moving the deposition changes the objective by more than the noise floor.
hypotheses.assessment: Baseline reproduced. Later experiments moved the objective in both directions by more than the refinement shift, so deposition radius is worth searching.

hypotheses.title: Moving deposition inward increases integrated fusion output at fixed energy
hypotheses.prediction: Deposition at rho 0.22 raises integrated fusion energy by at least 3.0% relative to the baseline.
hypotheses.assessment: The coarse run showed 4.7%, but refinement at dt 0.0125 s reduced the gain to 1.8%, below the 3.0% threshold fixed before the run. The direction of the effect survived; the claimed size did not.

hypotheses.title: Outward deposition is the better direction
hypotheses.prediction: Deposition at rho 0.50 raises integrated fusion energy above the baseline.
hypotheses.assessment: Objective fell 5.3% below baseline. Direction discarded after one experiment.

hypotheses.title: A narrower deposition compounds the inward gain
hypotheses.prediction: Width 0.06 at rho 0.22 exceeds the gain measured for candidate A.
hypotheses.assessment: The simulation did not reach the requested horizon, so no objective value exists for this configuration. Not retried within the remaining budget.

hypotheses.title: Shortening the pulse while raising power holds total energy fixed
hypotheses.prediction: Doubling power over half the duration keeps 100 MJ and improves the objective.
hypotheses.assessment: Rejected by the harness before execution: duration is a frozen parameter for this question, so the configuration was never run.

checks.name: fixed heating energy
checks.detail: 100.0 MJ delivered, matching the frozen budget.

checks.name: solver converged
checks.detail: No step rejected; requested horizon completed.

experiments.label: Candidate C — narrow deposition, width 0.06
experiments.error: Solver did not converge at t = 1.85 s; step rejected 12 times at dt = 0.05 s.

checks.name: numerical convergence
checks.detail: Objective shifted 0.8% against the coarse run.

experiments.label: Refinement — candidate A at dt 0.0125 s

checks.name: numerical convergence
checks.detail: Objective shift against the coarse run inside tolerance.

checks.name: minimum meaningful improvement
checks.detail: Refined gain 1.8% is below the 3.0% threshold fixed before the run.

checks.name: equal-budget grid search
checks.detail: Grid best overlaps the candidate interval.

events.title: Run started
events.summary: Question, parameter bounds, objective and budget frozen. Twelve experiments authorised.

events.title: Reproduce the baseline first
events.summary: Before searching, confirm the documented configuration reproduces its recorded objective.

events.title: Baseline requested
events.summary: Documented configuration: 20 MW over 5 s, deposition at rho 0.35.

events.title: Baseline running
events.summary: Executor accepted the configuration and began the run.

events.title: Baseline completed
events.summary: Horizon reached. Integrated fusion energy 37.16 MJ under the frozen objective definition.

events.title: Baseline accepted as the reference
events.summary: All four checks passed. Deposition radius is worth searching within the reviewed bounds.

events.title: Try moving the deposition inward
events.summary: Predicts at least a 3.0% gain in integrated fusion energy at rho 0.22.

events.title: Candidate A requested
events.summary: Deposition moved to rho 0.22 with the width and total energy unchanged.

events.title: Consider shortening the pulse
events.summary: Proposes doubling power over half the duration at the same total energy.

events.title: Pulse-shortening rejected before execution
events.summary: Duration is frozen for this question. Validation refused the configuration and it was never run.

events.title: Candidate A running
events.summary: Executor accepted the configuration and began the run.

events.title: Outward direction opened as a sibling
events.summary: A second child hypothesis tests the opposite direction so the search is not one-sided.

events.title: Candidate B requested
events.summary: Deposition moved outward to rho 0.50, width and total energy unchanged.

events.title: Candidate A completed
events.summary: Integrated fusion energy 38.92 MJ, 4.7% above baseline at the coarse timestep.

events.title: Candidate B running
events.summary: Executor accepted the configuration and began the run.

events.title: Candidate B completed
events.summary: Integrated fusion energy 35.17 MJ, 5.3% below baseline.

events.title: Narrow the deposition
events.summary: Predicts that width 0.06 at rho 0.22 compounds the inward gain.

events.title: Candidate C requested
events.summary: Width reduced to 0.06 at rho 0.22, total energy unchanged.

events.title: Candidate C running
events.summary: Executor accepted the configuration and began the run.

events.title: Candidate C failed
events.summary: Solver did not converge at t = 1.85 s. No objective value exists for this configuration.

events.title: Narrow deposition left unresolved
events.summary: A failed run is not evidence against the hypothesis. Not retried within the remaining budget.

events.title: Refinement requested for baseline and candidate A
events.summary: Both re-run at dt 0.0125 s with an alternative solver before any claim is made.

events.title: Refined baseline completed
events.summary: Objective shifted 0.8% against the coarse run, inside the declared tolerance.

events.title: Refined candidate A completed
events.summary: Gain against the refined baseline is 1.8%, below the 3.0% minimum fixed before the run.

events.title: Claimed improvement does not survive refinement
events.summary: The direction of the effect holds; its magnitude does not clear the pre-registered threshold.

events.title: No supported improvement within budget
events.summary: Inward deposition moves the objective in the predicted direction, but the best refined gain of 1.8% did not clear the 3.0% minimum.

events.title: Run completed
events.summary: Six experiments executed, one of them failed. Budget was not exhausted.

conclusion.title: No supported improvement within budget
conclusion.summary: Inward deposition moved the objective in the predicted direction, but after refinement at dt 0.0125 s the best candidate gained 1.8% against a 3.0% minimum fixed before the run. The direction is worth further study; the improvement is not claimed.
